messages:
Ana (People Ops): @channel FYI: Atlanta office on-site hours will be flexible tomorrow due to an extreme heat advisory. Options: WFH, shortened day (9-1), or come in early for the cooling center shift. Please indicate your plan in this thread.

Marcus (Facilities): A/C vendors are on site but repairs may take all day. We'll open the south conference rooms (lower temp) and hand out cold packs. Water stations will be restocked every hour.

Riley (Office Admin): Cooling center shifts: 8:00-11:00, 11:00-14:00. Volunteers get a $15 meal voucher. Reply with "shift: 8-11" or "shift: 11-14" to sign up.

Kenji: shift: 8-11. Can I reserve a quiet desk after my shift?

Riley (Office Admin): Yes Kenji — we'll hold Desk A12 for you from 11:30-16:00.

Priya: If I WFH, is it still a paid workday? My daycare schedules are impacted.

Ana (People Ops): Yes — WFH or the shortened day are paid. If you need childcare support because of the heat, submit "heat-childcare" expense and tag me; we'll fast-track approvals for up to $80 for the day.

Theresa (Security): Building doors will remain unlocked for the cooling center entrances 07:45-15:00. Security staff will be present. If you bring a guest, drop their full name here for badge pre-clearance.

Marcus (Facilities): For those driving: Visitor Lot B will have shaded parking spots marked with orange cones. If you need an EV charger reserved, DM me with your plate.

Kenji: Thanks. Also, is there fan/desk A/C allowed? My laptop overheats otherwise.

Marcus (Facilities): Small fans OK if they don't block aisles. No personal space heaters. If your laptop needs cooling, we have spare laptop coolers at the front desk.

climate-bot: local-weather-bot alert: Heat advisory in effect 12:00-20:00 tomorrow. Stay hydrated.

Ana (People Ops): TL;DR: choose WFH / shortened day / cooling center shift. Sign up for shifts or reply here. Childcare support available via expense. We'll post a final logistics note by 7pm tonight. Stay cool everyone :sunglasses:
